WITH markers AS (
            SELECT s.module_catalogue_id,coalesce(o.status,s.status) AS status,coalesce(o.scheduled_start,s.start_datetime) AS start,
              coalesce(o.scheduled_end,coalesce(o.scheduled_start,s.start_datetime) + s.duration_minutes * interval '1 minute') AS finish,
              CASE WHEN coalesce(o.attendance_report_id,'')='' THEN NULL ELSE EXISTS(
                SELECT 1 FROM curriculum.live_session_attendance a WHERE a.occurrence_id=o.id
                AND lower(btrim(a.email))=%s AND a.total_attendance_seconds>0) END AS attended ,s.id AS session_id,s.module_catalogue_id AS module_id,s.module_title,
              s.start_datetime,s.duration_minutes,s.join_url AS series_join_url,s.status AS series_status,
              o.id AS occurrence_id,o.scheduled_start,o.scheduled_end,o.join_url
              FROM curriculum.live_sessions s LEFT JOIN curriculum.live_session_occurrences o ON o.live_session_id=s.id
              WHERE s.module_catalogue_id=ANY(%s) AND lower(s.status) NOT IN ('cancelled','deleted','failed','superseded')
              AND (o.id IS NULL AND coalesce(s.repeat_pattern,'') IN ('','none') OR o.id IS NOT NULL
                   AND lower(o.status) NOT IN ('cancelled','deleted','failed','superseded')) AND (coalesce(o.scheduled_start,s.start_datetime) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London')::date=%s::date
            ), dated AS (
              SELECT *, (start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London')::date AS day FROM markers WHERE start IS NOT NULL
            ) SELECT DISTINCT ON (module_catalogue_id,day) module_catalogue_id,day,attended,start,finish,status,session_id,module_id,module_title,start_datetime,duration_minutes,
              series_join_url,series_status,occurrence_id,scheduled_start,scheduled_end,join_url
              FROM dated ORDER BY module_catalogue_id,day,start

WITH markers AS (
            SELECT s.module_catalogue_id,coalesce(o.status,s.status) AS status,coalesce(o.scheduled_start,s.start_datetime) AS start,
              coalesce(o.scheduled_end,coalesce(o.scheduled_start,s.start_datetime) + s.duration_minutes * interval '1 minute') AS finish,
              CASE WHEN coalesce(o.attendance_report_id,'')='' THEN NULL ELSE EXISTS(
                SELECT 1 FROM curriculum.live_session_attendance a WHERE a.occurrence_id=o.id
                AND lower(btrim(a.email))=%s AND a.total_attendance_seconds>0) END AS attended ,s.id AS session_id,s.module_catalogue_id AS module_id,s.module_title,
              s.start_datetime,s.duration_minutes,s.join_url AS series_join_url,s.status AS series_status,
              o.id AS occurrence_id,o.scheduled_start,o.scheduled_end,o.join_url
              FROM curriculum.live_sessions s LEFT JOIN curriculum.live_session_occurrences o ON o.live_session_id=s.id
              WHERE s.module_catalogue_id=ANY(%s) AND lower(s.status) NOT IN ('cancelled','deleted','failed','superseded')

              SELECT *, (start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London')::date AS day FROM markers WHERE start IS NOT NULL

        u.id AS account_record_id,u."Email" AS account_email,u.aptem_id AS account_aptem_id,
        u."Planned_hours" AS programme_planned_hours
        FROM "Learner".learners l
        LEFT JOIN enrolment."Created_users" u ON u.id=l.enrolment_id
        WHERE l.enrolment_id=%s
SELECT "Learner"."learners"."id", "Learner"."learners"."enrolment_id" FROM "Learner"."learners" WHERE "Learner"."learners"."enrolment_id" = %s ORDER BY "Learner"."learners"."id" ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT module_ids
FROM curriculum.groups
WHERE group_name = %s AND (programme_name = %s OR programme_id = %s)
  AND deleted_at IS NULL
  AND COALESCE(is_programme_deleted, FALSE) = FALSE
ORDER BY
    -- jsonb_array_length() errors on a scalar, and this column is not
    -- guaranteed to hold an array -- the parsing in _group_module_ids allows
    -- for a string too. Anything that is not an array sorts as empty.
    jsonb_array_length(
        CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(module_ids) = 'array'
             THEN module_ids ELSE '[]'::jsonb END
    ) DESC,
    updated_at DESC NULLS LAST,
    created_at DESC NULLS LAST,
    group_id
LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT c.curriculum_module_ref AS module_id
        FROM "Learner".learner_source_course_memberships membership
        JOIN curriculum.source_courses c ON c.id=membership.source_course_id
        WHERE membership.learner_id=%s AND membership.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND c.deleted_at IS NULL AND nullif(c.curriculum_module_ref,'') IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY c.curriculum_module_ref

SELECT m.module_catalogue_id AS id,m.title,m.start_date,m.end_date,
            m.weeks_number,m.sessions_number,m.cohort_id,
            to_jsonb(m)->'session_holidays' AS session_holidays,
            to_jsonb(m)->'session_overrides' AS session_overrides,
            to_jsonb(m)->'weekly_schedule' AS weekly_schedule,
            coalesce(nullif(m.session_week_day,''),g.session_week_day) AS session_week_day,
            coalesce(nullif(m.session_start_time,''),g.session_start_time) AS session_start_time,
            coalesce(nullif(m.session_end_time,''),g.session_end_time) AS session_end_time
            FROM curriculum.modules m LEFT JOIN curriculum.groups g ON g.group_id=m.group_id
            WHERE m.module_catalogue_id=ANY(%s) ORDER BY m.title

SELECT id,module_catalogue_id,week_number,title,holiday_note_enabled,holiday_note,display_order
            FROM curriculum.weeks WHERE module_catalogue_id=ANY(%s) AND (weeks.deleted_at IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM curriculum.modules archived_module WHERE archived_module.module_catalogue_id=weeks.module_catalogue_id AND archived_module.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(weeks.deleted_via_parent, '') <> '' AND weeks.deleted_via_parent IN (archived_module.module_catalogue_id, archived_module.deleted_via_parent) AND weeks.deleted_at BETWEEN archived_module.deleted_at - interval '5 minutes' AND archived_module.deleted_at + interval '5 minutes'))
            ORDER BY display_order,week_number,id

SELECT 'cohort' AS source,to_jsonb(c) AS payload FROM "curriculum"."cohorts" c WHERE "cohort_id" in (%s) UNION ALL SELECT 'england',to_jsonb(h) FROM "curriculum"."england_holidays" h UNION ALL SELECT 'authored',to_jsonb(h) FROM "curriculum"."holidays" h

SELECT c.id,c.week_id,c.module_catalogue_id,c.type,
            coalesce(l.quiz_id, CASE WHEN c.settings_json->>'linkedQuizId' ~ '^[0-9]+$'
                THEN (c.settings_json->>'linkedQuizId')::bigint END) AS quiz_id,
            EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM curriculum.quizzes q WHERE q.id=coalesce(l.quiz_id,
                CASE WHEN c.settings_json->>'linkedQuizId' ~ '^[0-9]+$'
                THEN (c.settings_json->>'linkedQuizId')::bigint END)) AS is_quiz,
            CASE WHEN lower(replace(c.type,'-','_')) <> 'video' THEN true ELSE
              coalesce(btrim(c.settings_json->>'videoUrl'),'') <> '' OR coalesce(btrim(c.settings_json->>'readingContent'),'') <> '' OR coalesce(btrim(c.settings_json->>'podcastUrl'),'') <> '' OR coalesce(btrim(c.settings_json->>'audioUrl'),'') <> '' OR coalesce(btrim(c.settings_json->>'liveSessionUrl'),'') <> '' OR coalesce(btrim(c.settings_json->>'teamsMeetingUrl'),'') <> '' OR coalesce(btrim(c.settings_json->>'resourceUrl'),'') <> '' OR coalesce(btrim(c.settings_json->>'presentationUrl'),'') <> '' OR coalesce(btrim(c.settings_json->>'externalUrl'),'') <> '' OR coalesce(btrim(c.settings_json->>'fileUrl'),'') <> '' OR coalesce(btrim(c.settings_json->>'uploadedFileUrl'),'') <> '' OR coalesce(btrim(c.settings_json->>'url'),'') <> '' OR coalesce(c.settings_json->>'embedCode','') ~* '<iframe[^>]+src=["'']([^"'']+)["'']' OR
              coalesce(btrim(c.live_sessions_link),'') <> '' END AS has_content
            FROM curriculum.components c LEFT JOIN curriculum.quiz_component_links l ON l.component_id=c.id
            JOIN curriculum.modules cm ON cm.module_catalogue_id=c.module_catalogue_id
            WHERE c.module_catalogue_id=ANY(%s) AND (c.deleted_at IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM curriculum.modules archived_module WHERE archived_module.module_catalogue_id=c.module_catalogue_id AND archived_module.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(c.deleted_via_parent, '') <> '' AND c.deleted_via_parent IN (archived_module.module_catalogue_id, archived_module.deleted_via_parent) AND c.deleted_at BETWEEN archived_module.deleted_at - interval '5 minutes' AND archived_module.deleted_at + interval '5 minutes'))
            AND (cm.deleted_at IS NULL OR COALESCE(cm.deleted_via_parent,'') <> '') AND coalesce(btrim(cm.title),'') <> ''
             AND (c.week_id=%s OR l.quiz_id IS NOT NULL
                OR c.settings_json->>'linkedQuizId' ~ '^[0-9]+$')
            ORDER BY c.week_id,c.display_order,c.id

SELECT "Learner"."learner_progress_entries"."kind" AS "kind", "Learner"."learner_progress_entries"."component_ref" AS "component_ref", "Learner"."learner_progress_entries"."quiz_ref" AS "quiz_ref", "Learner"."learner_progress_entries"."passed" AS "passed", "Learner"."learner_progress_entries"."submitted_at" AS "submitted_at" FROM "Learner"."learner_progress_entries" WHERE ("Learner"."learner_progress_entries"."learner_id" = %s AND "Learner"."learner_progress_entries"."kind" IN (%s, %s, %s, %s) AND ("Learner"."learner_progress_entries"."component_ref" IN (%s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s, %s) OR "Learner"."learner_progress_entries"."kind" = %s)) ORDER BY "Learner"."learner_progress_entries"."entry_order" ASC, "Learner"."learner_progress_entries"."id" ASC

WITH markers AS (
            SELECT s.module_catalogue_id,coalesce(o.status,s.status) AS status,coalesce(o.scheduled_start,s.start_datetime) AS start,
              coalesce(o.scheduled_end,coalesce(o.scheduled_start,s.start_datetime) + s.duration_minutes * interval '1 minute') AS finish,
              CASE WHEN coalesce(o.attendance_report_id,'')='' THEN NULL ELSE EXISTS(
                SELECT 1 FROM curriculum.live_session_attendance a WHERE a.occurrence_id=o.id
                AND lower(btrim(a.email))=%s AND a.total_attendance_seconds>0) END AS attended ,s.id AS session_id,s.module_catalogue_id AS module_id,s.module_title,
              s.start_datetime,s.duration_minutes,s.join_url AS series_join_url,s.status AS series_status,
              o.id AS occurrence_id,o.scheduled_start,o.scheduled_end,o.join_url
              FROM curriculum.live_sessions s LEFT JOIN curriculum.live_session_occurrences o ON o.live_session_id=s.id
              WHERE s.module_catalogue_id=ANY(%s) AND lower(s.status) NOT IN ('cancelled','deleted','failed','superseded')
              AND (o.id IS NULL AND coalesce(s.repeat_pattern,'') IN ('','none') OR o.id IS NOT NULL
                   AND lower(o.status) NOT IN ('cancelled','deleted','failed','superseded')) AND (coalesce(o.scheduled_start,s.start_datetime) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London')::date=%s::date
            ), dated AS (
              SELECT *, (start AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/London')::date AS day FROM markers WHERE start IS NOT NULL
            ) SELECT DISTINCT ON (module_catalogue_id,day) module_catalogue_id,day,attended,start,finish,status,session_id,module_id,module_title,start_datetime,duration_minutes,
              series_join_url,series_status,occurrence_id,scheduled_start,scheduled_end,join_url
              FROM dated ORDER BY module_catalogue_id,day,start

SELECT c.id,c.title,c.type,c.ksb_mappings,
            CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(c.settings_json->'durationMinutes')='number'
                THEN c.settings_json->>'durationMinutes' END AS duration_minutes,
            q.title AS quiz_title,q.duration AS quiz_duration,q.time_unit AS quiz_time_unit,
            l.quiz_id AS linked_quiz_id,q.id AS resolved_quiz_id,q.questions AS quiz_questions
            FROM curriculum.components c LEFT JOIN curriculum.quiz_component_links l ON l.component_id=c.id
            LEFT JOIN curriculum.quizzes q ON q.id=coalesce(l.quiz_id,
                CASE WHEN c.settings_json->>'linkedQuizId' ~ '^[0-9]+$' THEN (c.settings_json->>'linkedQuizId')::bigint END)
            WHERE c.id=ANY(%s) ORDER BY c.display_order,c.id

SELECT component_id,ksb_code FROM curriculum.ksb_mappings
            WHERE component_id=ANY(%s) AND (ksb_mappings.deleted_at IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM curriculum.modules archived_module WHERE archived_module.module_catalogue_id=ksb_mappings.module_catalogue_id AND archived_module.deleted_at IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(ksb_mappings.deleted_via_parent, '') <> '' AND ksb_mappings.deleted_via_parent IN (archived_module.module_catalogue_id, archived_module.deleted_via_parent) AND ksb_mappings.deleted_at BETWEEN archived_module.deleted_at - interval '5 minutes' AND archived_module.deleted_at + interval '5 minutes')) ORDER BY component_id,ksb_code

SELECT progress.id,progress.learner_id,progress.kind,progress.module_ref,progress.module_title,progress.component_ref,progress.component_type,progress.quiz_ref,progress.passed,progress.reported_time,progress.submitted_at,progress.started_at,progress.time_tracking_source,progress.claimed_seconds,progress.verified_seconds,progress.source_system,progress.component_link_source,progress.actual_seconds,progress.accepted,
        to_jsonb(progress)->>'actual_basis' AS actual_basis,
        CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(progress.source_payload)='object' THEN
          jsonb_build_object('original_source_ref',progress.source_payload->'original_source_ref')
          ELSE progress.source_payload END AS source_payload,
        CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM "Learner".learner_activity_reporting_segments s
          WHERE s.progress_id=progress.id AND s.learner_id=progress.learner_id)
          THEN '[{}]'::jsonb ELSE '[]'::jsonb END AS segments
        FROM "Learner".learner_progress_entries progress
        WHERE progress.learner_id=%s AND progress.deleted_at IS NULL
        ORDER BY progress.reporting_month,progress.reporting_started_at NULLS LAST,progress.id
